title: KML Path Length: Distance of a Drawn Path
description: Measure supported KML LineString length from spherical segment distances. Extract KMZ archives before opening.
summary_sentence: LineString lengths are summed separately; polygon boundaries are excluded and KMZ archives must be extracted first.
quick_answer: Open an uncompressed KML file to display supported placemarks and sum the spherical lengths of LineStrings in kilometres and miles. Separate lines are not joined; polygons are excluded.

Estimate lengths of cable runs or fence lines drawn as LineStrings. These are surface estimates, not survey measurements.
Open each route variant separately and compare the displayed LineString totals.
A path with several coordinates is measured as the sum of spherical distances between consecutive points. KML tuples use longitude,latitude order.
A hand-drawn path or sparsely sampled track can miss bends. The result measures the supplied geometry, not necessarily the route travelled.

faq: No. The total includes supported LineStrings only; polygon rings are excluded.

Really: KML's tuple order is longitude,latitude[,altitude] — the reverse of GPX and of everyday speech. The tool parses KML's convention natively; most hand-rolled scripts that get KML wrong, get this wrong.
Drawn in Google Earth versus recorded by GPS?
Both are measured from their supplied coordinates. Drawing, GPS noise and sampling can all affect the result.
A LineString whose last tuple returns to its first closes the loop in the sum. An unclosed 'loop' measures open — check the file if the total feels one leg short.
Does it follow roads or paths on the ground?
No — straight hops between the file's tuples, the geometry as drawn. Snapping to a path network is a routing engine's job.
Haversine hops are great-circle segments — a transcontinental LineString sums as the sphere dictates, which is the correct behaviour for a straight-line file.
A single-point or empty LineString is not rendered or counted as a line. If the file contains no supported visible placemarks, it will not open.
